name: 三国志
english_description: A Three-Kingdoms-themed Chinese MUD built on the Lima mudlib base (TMI-2/Ellery security lineage), already partially adapted by this project's own maintainer for a modern FluffOS driver before being folded into this collection. Players start from a Lima-style wizard hall, roll a talent template (valor/strategy/charisma archetypes), and build a career across a real map of Three-Kingdoms-era cities, garrisons and nations -- recruiting personal troops, riding named historical horses, and taking government office.
